notes.title: Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022268/da9aa0f53b249bad6b4723cf8155f4db2d41e5a1.gif[/img]

Added object "Homing missile"
- Added the ability to register via Login-Password
- Added restriction of intersection with other objects in the level editor
- Fixed a bug when interacting with water (now does not freeze)
- When exiting the map editor, the level is now saved automatically
- Added restriction of intersection with other objects in the level editor for the character and the homing missile
- Fixed bug with camera zoom when player finishes
- Added the ability to skip training
